*“If we stay here, if we keep wandering without a real plan, we won’t last. Maybe The Hill is dangerous. But maybe it’s not. It’s the only plan we have.”*

Seventeen-year-old Aurora knows how to survive. Life in the foster system has taught her how to stay quiet, stay smart, and stay ready. But nothing could prepare her for this: a never-ending storm that swallows cities, drowns forests, and turns the world into a flooded wasteland.

Trapped in a collapsing house with her strict prepper foster parents, Aurora is forced to live by their rules just to stay alive. Until the day they disappear without a trace.

**Alone. Abandoned.** And **running out of time.**

All Aurora has is a waterlogged scrap of paper and a “The Hill.”

With looters closing in and the floodwaters rising higher each day, she’s left with **one impossible choice**—stay and wait for the storm to take her, or risk everything on a journey through the drowned remains of the world, to a find a place that may or not exist.

It’s forward or nothing.

releases.synopsis: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.

releases.title: Ashen Swarm
releases.synopsis: Ashen Swarm is a single-player gothic arena roguelite in which abilities are based on the seven deadly sins. Players combine skills during each run and choose between keeping an Oath or gaining powers through Corruption. Decisions in recurring narrative events grant lasting artifacts. A gathering court culminates in a battle against the Collegium.

releases.title: Hamster Wheel Isekai
releases.synopsis: Hamster Wheel Isekai combines incremental progression with role-playing mechanics. Players power a wheel, change gears and time shifts to build speed and advance.

releases.title: Calmaria: Wild Growth
releases.synopsis: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.

releases.title: Last Chance: Birth
releases.synopsis: Enter the magic school of Academia! Last Chance: Birth is the mix of a narrative game and casual puzzles, where your performance impacts how the story is told. Solve puzzles to cast spells, to craft potions, to enchant artifacts and more!

releases.title: Marvel Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
releases.synopsis:
Marvel Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom includes two new playable characters and a new game mode.

The Fantastic Four's most powerful member and their greatest adversary are joining the fight against Annihilus!

Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom head to Marvel Cosmic Invasion for an intergalactic adventure that will see them face off against the fearsome Annihilation Wave!

The Siege of Castle Doom will put the leader of Latveria at the center of its new game mode, set in the nefarious Castle Doomstadt!

releases.title: Protocell
releases.synopsis: Mutation is evolution. A lab cell broke containment — pilot it through swarming arenas where every upgrade you take drags you closer to meltdown. Grow billions of one-of-a-kind protocells, hand any of them to a friend with a 16-character code, and dive into the Primordial Abyss.

releases.title: Powder Park
releases.synopsis: Every other resort builder stops at the blueprint. Powder Park doesn't. Shape the mountain, design your runs, then drop in and ride them yourself in third person. A new experience from one of the original creators of Ski Resort Tycoon.

releases.title: The Adventures of Tango Rio
releases.synopsis:
A humoristic point-and-click adventure with hand-drawn 2D art, comedy, and investigation. As Tango Rio, explore a tropical archipelago, meet quirky characters, and gather clues by solving puzzles in the search for your mysteriously vanished father.

Tango Rio hasn’t seen his father in two years—not since he left with his uncle on “a journey that would change the world.” Or so he claimed. Then, silence.

The only clue: the name of a Polynesian archipelago... and the feeling that this time, the escape is different.

What awaits him? Tropical legends, strange rituals, time travel, dark prophecies, and a bunch of totally crazy characters.

releases.title: Football Manager 27 Mobile
releases.synopsis: FM27 Mobile will be available on iOS and Android exclusively via Netflix.

releases.title: Football Manager 27 Console
releases.synopsis: Flow from the tactics board to the touchline in FM27 Console, where a smoother, more immersive experience invites discovery from the moment your career begins.

releases.title: Football Manager 27
releases.synopsis: Flow from the tactics board to the touchline in FM27, as foundations evolve to deliver greater control, smoother discovery and a richer footballing world to explore.

releases.title: Dead March: Dark Lord Rising
releases.synopsis: Dark Lord! The Dead March has begun. Raise an army of Hell, attack and plunder settlements for resources. Grow your Dark Power, unlock new abilities, and upgrade your forces to conquer the capital of the human kingdom. Satan will judge your every battle.

releases.title: Edge of the Blade
releases.synopsis: Edge of the Blade is a roguelite grand-strategy autobattler where you choose one of three factions and fight over the ruined land of Cheonggu. Set weekly war objectives, capture strongholds, deploy your army, and shape the flow of battle through your choices.

releases.title: Rense
releases.synopsis: A fast roguelite FPS. Make your build from level-up power choices and chest items, and fight through three maps of hostile drones. The longer a run goes, the stronger they get. Die, unlock more, come back stronger.

releases.title: No More Ground
releases.synopsis: No More Ground is a 3D action game where you use your parkour skills to climb, climb, and climb again to reach the top. You start in a city, jump across rooftops, and climb through structures suspended in the sky. One wrong move can send you back down, so every jump counts and making it to the top feels even better. Wall run, swing from bars, and use all your parkour skills to make your way through the course.

releases.title: Crash Relay
releases.synopsis: Crash Relay is a chaotic multiplayer racing game where 10 players share 5 vehicles in teams of two. One player controls acceleration and braking, while the other handles steering and weapons. Use weapons, special abilities, and teamwork to survive chaotic races and reach the finish line first.

releases.title: The Last Zeppelin
releases.synopsis: A casual, retro-inspired 2D shooter with an alt-history twist! Pilot the last German Zeppelin in a parallel universe against a reptilian army. Master your Zero-Energy Impulse and blast through biplanes, pterosaurs and flying saucers. Simple controls, escalating difficulty, and pure arcade action.

releases.title: Vinculum
releases.synopsis: Do the math and survive the aftermath. An easy-to-learn card battler: pull off math combos, get stuck in a fraction, stack functions until the numbers go absurd, break the enemy lines, try not to divide by zero. Real, modern, correct math. But when math isn't enough, resort to more arcane means...

releases.title: It Thinks!
releases.synopsis: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

releases.title: Clogwork
releases.synopsis: CLOGWORK is a factory-automation game where you turn random pieces into final shapes. Build conveyor belts, glue, cut and rotate parts, wire logic signals, and send the finished shape to the hub to fulfil ever-changing orders.

releases.title: Drawmi: Creature Collector
releases.synopsis: A creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree.

releases.title: Drawmi: Card Shop
releases.synopsis: Drawmi: Card Shop is an immersive simulator where you and your friends can draw all the cards you sell and run a thriving card shop together.
